title: Ninataka kuamua mara moja kwamba maisha yangu ni ya kufurahisha, na kuacha kuiangalia kila wakati

text.I want to decide once that my life is fu: Ninataka kuamua mara moja kwamba maisha yangu ni ya kufurahisha, na kuacha kuiangalia kila wakati
text.I want to value, in my life, not judging: Ninataka kuthamini, katika maisha yangu, bila kuhukumu kila wakati tena.
text.I decide that it is fun. I decide to enj: Ninaamua kuwa ni ya kufurahisha. Ninaamua kufurahia.
text.If someone asks me \"Are you looking for: Mtu akiniuliza "Je, unatazamia?", Ninatazamia kwa hamu.
text.In other words, maybe happy people do no: Kwa maneno mengine, labda watu wenye furaha hawachunguzi kila wakati ikiwa wana furaha. Labda tayari wameamua kwamba maisha yao ni ya furaha na daima ni mazuri.
text.I also want to fix my interpretation, an: Pia nataka kurekebisha tafsiri yangu, na kuanzia leo nataka kuwa mtu anayejibu, anafurahiya kila wakati, mzuri kila wakati, mwenye furaha kila wakati.
text.Another tip for difficult documents at w: Kidokezo kingine cha hati ngumu kazini: soma kila sentensi kutoka kushoto
text.A tip for difficult documents at work: r: Kidokezo kwa hati ngumu kazini: soma jedwali la yaliyomo tu
